docs.text: Lake Superior is by far the greatest Great Lake. Glad to be able to get a nice run in while we were here. Makes me a little sad I didn't start running until I moved away. #Running #LakeSuperior #Marquette #Michigan #Moskey
I love Lake Superior. Well all he great lakes I'm from Michigan.

Just went thigh high in Lake Huron ! She’s a beaut. Clear water. Larger surface area than Lake Michigan but is pretty shallow! LM is much deeper w/ less surface area. Superior is superior and there’s no arguing against that.
It really is. I love the lower, but the upper is my favorite. The Porkies and Lake of the Clouds, Marquette, snowmobiling, all the waterfalls. Lake Superior. Lake Michigan. So so grogeous.

I love lake Michigan and it's the one I have the most experience with, but superior is superior in more than just name. Try not to tell too many people. There aren't many places that haven't been ruined by tourists left out there.
This Minnesota girl thinks Lake Superior is overrated. (Hey UMich! Please let her in!) .edu .bsky.social
The two coasts are kind of ostentatiously beautiful, so we forget that Lake Michigan is also lovely. The Great Lakes are great for a reason.
I've done lake Michigan before, but Superior feels so much more intimidating
I grew up on Lake Michigan but I adore Superior equally. The two Greatest Lakes, to be sure.
I grew up near Lake Michigan and have visited Superior, haven't interacted with any of the others. But those two can be quite fierce.
Oof, Lake Superior, always the best of the Lakes. Fight me, Midwesterners! 🙃 .bsky.social
I had Great Lakes but now it’s Nelnet and omg. I haven’t seen this score since college.
